description: This file is a JavaScript implementation of Bootstrap's collapse component (version 2.0.4), providing functionality for collapsible UI elements such as accordions.

classes.name: Collapse
classes.description: A class managing the collapse behavior of elements, including show, hide, toggle, and reset functionalities.

methods.name: Collapse.prototype.dimension
methods.description: Determines whether the collapse element uses width or height for its animation.

methods.name: Collapse.prototype.show
methods.description: Expands the collapse element, handling active siblings and triggering transition events.

methods.name: Collapse.prototype.hide
methods.description: Collapses the element, triggering transition events.

methods.name: Collapse.prototype.reset
methods.description: Resets the element's size to a specified value, managing CSS classes accordingly.

methods.name: Collapse.prototype.transition
methods.description: Handles the transition animation for showing or hiding the collapse element.

methods.name: Collapse.prototype.toggle
methods.description: Toggles between showing and hiding the collapse element.
